# telnyx_requirement_group (Resource)

A group of answers to the regulatory requirements of phone numbers in a country.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) One of `ordering`, `porting`.
- `country_code` (String) ISO alpha 2 country code
- `phone_number_type` (String) One of `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.

### Optional

- `customer_reference` (String) Reference for the customer
- `regulatory_requirements` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regulatory_requirements))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `record_type` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--regulatory_requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regulatory_requirements`

Optional:

- `field_value` (String) New value for the regulatory requirement
- `requirement_id` (String) Unique identifier for the regulatory requirement

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `field_type` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_requirement_group.example <id>
```
